svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.09k stars in total, about 1.72k a year earlier. jactionlint 307, mr boxington 654, aube 2061, fnox 2347, hk 1296, pitchfork 703, usage 1067, +5 more 657.

g.text: $ gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/stargazers --paginate # every tool except mise
cumulative stars since Jan 2025, stacked by launch
